cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only typing the invitations. I'll check the details before anything goes out. What time did we settle on for Mum's dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven, in the private room. You booked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll keep the wording consistent with yours. How have you written the restaurant name?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't written anything. You're doing the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll use the booking confirmation as our master copy. Read it aloud to me while I type, starting with the name; we'll avoid any copying mistakes.

reason: Give S06 a modest concrete role that determines task order, terms, timing or information handling. Keep exact Drive and B successive contributions; preserve all source and original evidence.
